units.source_text: 苗子倏地满脸绯红，赶紧把头发捋在一起，卷了上去，

en.t: Naeko suddenly blushed crimson all over her face, hurriedly gathered her hair together, and twisted it up,

units.source_text: 然后准备用衔在嘴里的发夹别上，可是夹子散落一地，不够用了。

en.t: then was about to fasten it with the hairpins she was holding in her mouth, but the pins were scattered all over the floor, and there were not enough.
